design.heading: Design
design.lede: Brand identity, design systems, campaign key art, and launch creative. Eleven years of graphic design across Fender, PreSonus, and independent clients, working on global launches and available for travel. The work spans logo and identity systems, album art, packaging, social and campaign graphics, trade show environmental design, YouTube packaging, and e-commerce merchandising for global product launches.

photo.heading: Photo
photo.lede: Commercial, product, lifestyle, and portrait photography, shot and finished in house. US based and available worldwide, shooting from studio product tables to touring stages: campaign and lifestyle imagery, high-end transactional product shots, artist portraits, live music and event coverage, and on-location documentary work for national brands.
photo.seoDescription: Commercial, product, lifestyle, and portrait photography by Houston Dragna. Available worldwide, shooting on location for music and pro audio brands.
photo.shortDescription: Product, campaign, and lifestyle photography for pro audio and music brands.

video.heading: Video
video.lede: Brand film and campaign video, directed and produced in house from concept through final grade. Launch films, artist features, short-form social content, and technical demo work, including LED volume wall virtual production, traditional soundstage shoots, and documentary capture on location.

case-studies.heading: Case Studies
case-studies.lede: Three campaign breakdowns from Fender and PreSonus: a global software and hardware launch, the physical debut of a new brand identity at the NAMM Show, and a flagship console launch I pitched and directed end to end. Each covers the brief, the creative platform, the production, and what I personally owned across film, photography, sound, and design.
